lead.headline: San Antonio nurse practitioner Kim Hinojosa prescribed $24.9M of specialty drugs to Medicare patients in 2022, most of any NP
lead.number: $24.9M of specialty Part D drugs in 2022 (hepatitis C, bowel disease and psoriasis drugs), then $1.37M in 2024; specialty peers run $12-19M.
lead.watch_out: The community-clinic (FQHC) tie is a current-address join, not proof she worked there in 2022.

sources.page_context: Monday 7 am - 5 pm Tuesday 7 am - 5 pm Thursday 7 am - 5 pm Friday 7 am - 5 pm Wednesday 10 am - 5 pm About Mrs. Kim Hinojosa was born in Presque Isle, Maine and raised in the Bangor area. Kim attended St. Joseph’s college in Standish, ME for her BSN and graduated from UTHSCSA with her MSN in 2010. She graduated with high honors and has been a contributor in many published articles for HCV and hepatic encephalopathy. Mrs. Kim Hinojosa decided to become an Advanced Practice Clinician when she was ready to be on the outpatient side of care after working in critical care for both adults and pediatrics for 12 years.
